pages.text: Ostentum is a vanilla expansion built on $(l:https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fundamentum)Fundamentum$(/l). Nearly everything in it runs on Fundamentum's systems: the mounts, hooks, summons, whips, moons, siege night, elemental damage and portal crafting all come from Fundamentum, and Ostentum adds the items, mobs, art and recipes that use them.
pages.title: About Ostentum

pages.text: It needs Fundamentum and Curios. Saddles, hooks, summons and the Phantom Veil each go in their own Curios slot.
